name: button
title: Push button to ground with a pull-up
about: A push button pulls a signal to ground; a 10 kΩ pull-up holds it high while the button is open, also before the firmware runs. Without the resistor the MCU's internal pull-up does the job once the firmware has set it.

ports.in: the signal to the MCU input
ports.vcc: the logic supply of that input (3.3 V or 5 V)

notes: sim.json: the net under the MCU's inputs; the button under buttons in one load, so that LVL.threshold sees both levels.
On a strapping pin the pull-up must agree with the boot level (LVL.boot).
